comment: WebTiger's design tokens: the one source for every shell. Tools/design/tokens.py writes Swift from it (Kotlin and XAML join with their shells). Colours are #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, light then dark. The palette is provisional until the brand is settled (001 §9). A colour named space<Name> is the paint of the colour a Space can have that the core calls <name> (025): a mark, which has to be seen against the chip it stands in, and the generator measures that.
